officialSourceAssessment.registryEvidence: Official Geoportal Lot Plotter and Tabaco City cadastral/tax-map references were verified, but no anonymous parcel-vector response was verified. This is not evidence of citywide absence.

requestOutcomes: TLS-verified anonymous GET of https://geoportal.gov.ph/ and https://geoportal.gov.ph/gpapps/lotplotter returned HTTP 200. The current Lot Plotter JavaScript was fetched and inspected: it uses /lp/getlocations, /lp/getMunicipality/{province}, /lp/gettp/{province}/{municipality}, and a public WMS base URL, while the UI includes a slider CAPTCHA. Direct anonymous GETs to /lp/getlocations and /lp/getMunicipality/Albay returned HTTP 401 Unauthorized. The official Tabaco tax-map PDF URL returned HTTP 404 at request time; the FOI reference returned HTTP 403. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe-field request, or TLS exception was used.
